name: Minor-Nelson House

location.how: centre of the house's roof outline read on the Google straight-down view (pixel 730, 455 of aerial-close; 0.8 m east and 0.4 m south of the Google search's pin for the address, which labels the house '201'); the public ortho here is NAIP at 0.6 m, too coarse to place the centre better

standing.source: public orthos us-naip-2008 to us-naip-2023 (0.6 m); Google aerial 10/21/2023
standing.note: The same rotated main block with its rear ell and one-storey wings on every NAIP year 2008 to 2023 and on the Google view; no addition seen, at 0.6 m resolution only. The building is in commercial use (an antique shop per the 1999 drawing's text).

roof_shape: gable (two-story front block, ridge parallel to the street, with a front pediment); two-story rear block; one-story west and rear wings under lower roofs

plan.north: sheet up, tilted about 18 deg to the left (the arrow's solid half points up-left)
plan.note: Start at the west wing's sheet-top-left corner (outside face), walk clockwise. Parts: two-story front block 39'-3" x 22'-2" (sheet bottom right), two-story rear block above it (right wall 10'-7" in from the front block's right wall), a one-story rear wing and rear room across the top (top wall 14'-6" + 11'-2"), and the one-story west wing 15'-10" wide down the left side, split by an open recess with exterior steps (3'-7" wide) and fronted by an open porch. Scale on this sheet about 100.3 px/ft (from 39'-3", 22'-2", 24'-2", 20'-6", 16'-9").

disagreements.pass_a: 51'-5" (left string's segments, which the drawing scales to); overall 51'-8" declared a mismatch
disagreements.pass_b: 51'-8" (right string, with the printed 5'-4" the drawing shows as about 5.0 ft)
disagreements.resolved: A: both passes found the drawing scales 51.1 to 51.4 ft, which supports 51'-5"; areas differ 0.21 %, perimeters 0.30 %
the mean, 23.385 ft; B notes the printed scale bar reads about 3 % finer than the printed dimensions, which would raise every scaled height by about 3 %

flags.note: The chain's north-south extent is 51'-5" (the left string's segments 4'-10" + 20'-6" + 3'-7" + 16'-9" + 5'-9", which also match the drawing at 100.3 px/ft: 5156 px = 51.4 ft) against the right string's printed overall 51'-8". The right string's 51'-8" rests on a 5'-4" from the rear wall to the rear block that the drawing shows as 5.0 ft; the left string's own printed overall is 50'-7", matching neither. East-west: bottom 55'-1", top 54'-11", top middle row 55'-0"; the chain closes 1" open (55'-0" across the top, 55'-1" across the bottom), within tolerance.
Left string inner row (1", 2'-7", 6'-10", ...) does not fit the drawing at the plan's scale near the top (6'-10" spans 7.9 ft of drawing); not used.
The open stair recess on the west side is treated as outside the building (no wall across its mouth); its depth is scaled. If the steps sit inside a walled entry, add 3'-7" x 5'-3" (19 SF).
Second floor has no printed dimensions; its chain mixes first-floor printed values for the shared walls with scaled values (see the floor note).
